scripts.install:all: npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.emulators: npm run build && PATH="$(brew --prefix openjdk 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:start --only functions,hosting,firestore --project demo-emoji-guessr $([ -d .emulator-data ] && echo --import .emulator-data) --export-on-exit .emulator-data
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && npm run check:leaks && firebase deploy --only functions,hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.quiz: npm --prefix functions run build --silent && node scripts/quiz.mjs
